earliest_visible_sign.description: Small oval to elongated pale green, grey-green, or water-soaked spots

characteristic_sign_or_lesion.description: Long elliptical, spindle-shaped, or cigar-shaped lesions that are slender, oblong, and tapered at both ends

colors.color_progression: Initial water-soaked or pale spots elongate into grey-green lesions, which become tan/straw-coloured

shape_descriptors: runs broadly parallel to leaf veins or leaf margins
shape.shape_progression: oval early to cigar-shaped mature to irregular after coalescence

size.size_variation_note: Size varies with cultivar, infection timing, and environment.

texture_and_surface.sporulation_or_sign: Dark grey to olive-grey dusty or sooty fungal sporulation in mature lesions, especially visible on underside of infected leaves under humid conditions

border_and_margin.margin_type: runs broadly parallel to leaf veins or leaf margins

advanced_or_severe_stage.description: Extensive leaf blighting and premature leaf death
advanced_or_severe_stage.coalescence: Individual lesions enlarge and merge into irregular areas of dead tissue
advanced_or_severe_stage.tissue_death_appearance: Extensive leaf blighting, drying, brittleness; severe foliage damage can resemble frost injury
advanced_or_severe_stage.percentage_affected_tissue_note: Extensive leaf area destroyed causing whole-leaf or extensive canopy blighting

distribution_on_plant.vertical_pattern: Usually starts on lower leaves and progresses upward; late infections may be distributed throughout the canopy.
distribution_on_plant.horizontal_pattern: lesions run broadly parallel to leaf veins or leaf margins
distribution_on_plant.other_parts_if_severe: may extend to husk/ear covering in susceptible plants

pathognomonic_features: Long cigar-shaped lesions (3–15 cm) tapered at both ends
Dark grey to olive-grey dusty/sooty sporulation on the underside of mature lesions
